answer: Clone mills pack the voter roll with idle keys. To claim a ballot, an identity escrows 47 POA and plants a vine cutting on a numbered terrace along one reserved ledge slot. Five dawn readings, each signed by a different warden, must rise 8-14 mm; a one-use pith-hash may not collide with another key. Verify on-ledger: replay the ledge log and drop a reused slot or copied increment. Cost: 47 POA locked 12 days. If two keys share a ledge, a reading is flat, or the hash collides, 55% of the bond burns and that series is barred for 4 epochs; a warden signing two cuttings in one seed forfeits 9 POA.
